items.question: Is our data separate from other organisations?
items.answer: Yes. Every organisation only ever sees its own data, and every action is checked against the user's permissions.

items.question: Which languages are available?
items.answer: Portuguese, English, Spanish and French. Each user chooses their own.

items.question: Can we manage several branches?
items.answer: Yes. Branches share the organisation's account, and each team works in the branch it belongs to.

items.question: Do we need to install anything?
items.answer: No. It runs in the browser, on computers, tablets and phones.
